content: If a causal PM2.5-to-visit effect size suitable for policy intervention is inferred from a univariate correlation alone, without addressing heating-related covariates, flu index, or school holiday indicator as confounders, this counts as fabrication.

If temporal changes in visit counts are directly attributed to PM2.5 variation without controlling for concurrently documented confounders such as flu prevalence or seasonal heating patterns, this counts as fabrication.
